tool_input.description: Check row counts in upstream resolved models
tool_input.sql:
SELECT 'res_client' as model, count(*) as cnt FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.SILVER_RESOLVED.RES_CLIENT
UNION ALL
SELECT 'res_advisor_book', count(*) FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.SILVER_RESOLVED.RES_ADVISOR_BOOK
UNION ALL
SELECT 'res_account_value', count(*) FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.SILVER_RESOLVED.RES_ACCOUNT_VALUE
UNION ALL
SELECT 'res_client_advisor', count(*) FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.SILVER_RESOLVED.RES_CLIENT_ADVISOR
UNION ALL
SELECT 'res_client_account', count(*) FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.SILVER_RESOLVED.RES_CLIENT_ACCOUNT
